powder: fumed silica (Aerosil-type amorphous SiO2, ultra-low bulk density)

qc.reason: conveyance <= 0.25 mg/rev over 350 revolutions, but the delivery end could not be visually confirmed (draft cage blocks the bench camera) and block E tilt 0 deg carries a solenoid-impulse artifact

diagnostic.note: standard escalation, 45 revolutions; thresholds calibrated on powders with feed factors 100-1000x larger, so not informative for a 0.03-0.06 g/cm3 powder

long_integration.note: 350 continuous revolutions at tilt 90 deg to beat the balance noise floor; the decisive test, since a healthy fumed-silica feed is only a few mg per revolution
long_integration.verdict: conveying-slowly (module rule) -- read as no measurable conveyance

camera.reason: the improvised draft cage (cardboard box + plastic window) blocks the bench camera sightline; operator reports the tape was removed

amendments.author: claude
amendments.summary: Recorded as no measurable conveyance with the delivery end unverified; block E tilt 0 deg tap is an instrumentation artifact, not powder.
amendments.detail: 350 continuous revolutions at tilt 90 deg delivered a net 0.6 mg, so conveyance is at or below 0.25 mg per revolution -- at or below brown rice flour, the previous floor of the dataset. Block C cannot resolve it: every tilt mean sits inside one standard error of zero. The run stays excluded from cross-powder comparison for two independent reasons: the bench camera is blocked by the new draft cage so a taped or capped delivery end cannot be ruled out, and the block E tilt 0 deg tap quantum of 32.2 mg is larger than anything rotation delivered, which is physically impossible for powder and reads as the solenoid impulse coupling into the load cell.

block_c_not_resolved.note: every tilt mean is inside one standard error of zero; block A no-actuation spread was 10.5 mg peak-to-peak

block_e_tilt0_tap_artifact.note: a tap cannot deliver more than rotation brings to the lip; rotation at the same tilt in the same trials was negative. Read as the solenoid impulse coupling mechanically into the load cell, not powder.

outlet_not_visually_confirmed.reason: the improvised draft cage (cardboard box with a plastic window) blocks the bench-camera sightline
outlet_not_visually_confirmed.operator_statement: swcharles reports the delivery-end tape was removed
outlet_not_visually_confirmed.consequence: a genuinely non-conveying powder and a blocked delivery end are indistinguishable in this run
